label: Sixth-edition aphorisms
title: Aphorism § 162
text:
§ 162



Sometimes happens, owing to the moderate number of medicines yet known
          with respect to their true, pure action, that but a portion of the symptoms of the disease
          under treatment are to be met with in the list of symptoms of the most appropriate
          medicine, consequently this imperfect medicinal morbific agent must be employed for lack
          of a more perfect one.
